bayts.text: You are the Strong (Al-Qawī), Who have strengthened me with good pleasure, in secret and in the open, O Lord of the Command, O Allah.
You are the Firm (Al-Matīn), Who have been for me with aspirations, and You do not turn toward me what is hateful, O Allah.
You are the Protector (Al-Walī), in exchange for Whom I seek no substitute, and You have been for me with safety, O Allah.
You are the Praiseworthy (Al-Ḥamīd), Who have turned graces toward me, without delusion and without guile, O Allah.
O Reckoner (Al-Muḥṣī) of creation and of all things together, You have spared me the harm of what You have numbered, O Allah.
O Originator (Al-Mubdiʾ) of creation, O You Who do not turn toward me what I do not love: I am well pleased with You, O Allah.
O Restorer (Al-Muʿīd), You have led to me out of generosity the most praiseworthy of returns, in every month and day, in You, O Allah.
O Giver of life (Al-Muḥyī), with the best of lives You have been lavish to me forever: so to You is my gratitude, with purity of life, O Allah.
O Giver of death (Al-Mumīt), You have driven my death toward the enemies, and toward them You have driven my adversities, in the two Abodes, O Allah.
O Living (Al-Ḥayy), my praise and my gratitude, together with my contentment, accept them from me without displeasure on Your part, O Allah.
O Self-Subsisting (Al-Qayyūm), You have led to me what I sought, without my earning, until the Gardens, O Allah.
You have brought to me, O Finder (Al-Wājid), the prices without toil: Yours is the Existence that has become manifest to me, O Allah.
O Noble (Al-Mājid), make me exalted in the two Abodes, without pride or vanity, Lord, O Allah.
O One (Al-Wāḥid), make me singular in the two Abodes, with aspirations, through a precious gift from You, O Allah.
To You (goes) my refuge, in what has been chosen for me, O my Self-Sufficient (Aṣ-Ṣamad), as gladness for all those You have loved, O Allah.
You have cast down, O Able (Al-Qādir), the forsaken one, driven off toward others than us: to You be praise, O Allah.
You have granted me the Pilgrimage by folding (of the earth) — You are the All-Powerful — with nearness (to the Prophet) and the visit in You, O Allah.
You are the Expediter (Al-Muqaddim): bring me forward here and tomorrow before many of the elect, O Allah.
You are the Delayer (Al-Muʾakhkhir): You have removed the enemies, and they went off toward others than us, with disgrace, O Allah.
And truly You are the First (Al-Awwal): place me here and tomorrow among the forerunners, by grace from You, O Allah.
O Last (Al-Ākhir), make me possessed of ranks in the two Abodes, and purify my life until the Gardens, O Allah.
O Manifest (Aẓ-Ẓāhir), grant me what I hope for, well pleased with me, and make me manifest the Qurʾān, O Allah.
O Hidden (Al-Bāṭin), grant me the secrets, O Possessor of favours, and make my heart the vessel of remembrance, O Allah.
Grant me, by Your grace, O Governor (Al-Wālī), my union with the Best of creatures and with those You have befriended, O Allah.
And truly You are the Supremely Exalted (Al-Mutaʿālī): drive Your enemies, all together, toward other than the aim of harming me, forever, O Allah.
Expand, make master and set free, without corruption, and answer for me my supplication, O Beneficent (Al-Barr), O Allah.
You have turned to me (in forgiveness), effaced the sin entirely, purified my whole being, O Accepter of repentance (At-Tawwāb), O Allah.
You are the One Who takes vengeance (Al-Muntaqim) on the enemies of Islam, and for me You have avenged with what You chose for me, O Allah.
You are the Pardoner (Al-ʿAfuww), Who have pardoned me without leaving (any) fault: You have guided (my) whole (being), O Allah.
You are the Most Kind (Ar-Raʾūf), Whose kindness I have seen with my eyes, and You do not turn the enemies toward me, O Allah.
O King of Sovereignty (Mālik al-Mulk), for me You have widened, without anguish, in the Kingdom and the heavenly Dominion, forever, O Allah.
O Possessor of Majesty and Possessor of Generosity, grant me what You have chosen for me, in this world and the next, from You, O Allah.
Lead to me, O Equitable (Al-Muqsiṭ), what is sought, so that I be seen (as Your) intimate friend and beloved, with good pleasure, O Allah.
O Gatherer (Al-Jāmiʿ), gather my aims for me, well pleased with me, through Your being for me in the gathering, O Allah.
You are the Rich (Al-Ghanī), to Whom no aim pertains: grant me what I need, O Allah.
You have enriched me — You are the Enricher (Al-Mughnī) — without cause: so forever be for me with grace, O Allah.
You have given me — You are the Giver (Al-Muʿṭī) — the aspirations of the noble; You have spared me all the enemies, O Allah.
You have prevented, O Preventer (Al-Māniʿ), the evils from my side, and You do not turn toward me what grieves, O Allah.
You have prevented, O Distresser (Aḍ-Ḍārr), harm from me forever, and You do not turn harming toward me, O Allah.
You have led to me in everything the benefit of a Generous One, O Benefactor (An-Nāfiʿ) of those who have faith, O Allah.
You have illumined, O Light (An-Nūr), my whole being, pure, forever; You have spared me the darkness of things, O Allah.
You have led to me from You, O Guide (Al-Hādī), the guidance of those who were companions of the Chosen, the Elect, O Allah.
You are the Wondrous Originator (Al-Badīʿ), Whose wonders have appeared: You have led wonders to me with reward, O Allah.
Purify my life for me, O Everlasting (Al-Bāqī), with the best good pleasure, and make me endure through the Book of Allah, O Allah.
You have led to me all the favours You chose for me, as an inheritance, O Inheritor (Al-Wārith) of the dead, O Allah.
You are the Guide to the Right Path (Ar-Rashīd), Who have led to me right guidance in everything, with glad tidings, O Allah.
You are the Patient (Aṣ-Ṣabūr), Who have turned toward me a price (of reward), and You have taken away what refuses it, O Allah.
